name: Essex-class fleet carrier
blurb: The fleet carrier the player launches from and lands on.
history:
The Essex class was the 20th century's most numerous class of capital ship: 24 carriers were completed, in "short-hull" and "long-hull" versions, of 32 ordered. Fourteen saw combat in World War II, and none was lost to enemy action, although some were crippled by air attack.

Essex-class carriers were the backbone of the U.S. Navy from mid-1943 through the Korean War. Most were later rebuilt, and Lexington was the last to retire, as a training carrier in 1991. Yorktown, Hornet, Lexington and Intrepid are preserved as museum ships.
